core_obligations: Take a chain of specialisations in the source and bound its length by the local dimension at its end (proof lines 13762-13766).
Apply the dimension formula at that point and its image (proof lines 13766-13778).

proof_roadmap: Chain bounded by local dimension (proof lines 13762-13766).
difficulty_reason: The lemma proves the dimension inequality for a dominant morphism of integral schemes which is locally of finite type over a locally Noetherian base: the dimension of the source is at most the dimension of the target plus the transcendence degree of the function field extension, with equality when the morphism is closed. The proof takes a chain of specialisations in the source, bounds its length by the dimension of the local ring at its end point, then applies the dimension formula for the local rings at a point and its image, and drops the nonnegative correction term to get the inequality; the equality case is then derived in the remainder of the argument.
